text:
Clara: Quick check — tracing hook rollout to staging is blocked, seeing mismatched span IDs in the trace joiner. Anyone else seeing this?
Matt: I noticed it on the canary hop around 11:12. Logs show `ERROR: span_id mismatch for trace=abc123`
Omar: cc @Priya @Rui — did the agent change hit staging?
Priya: Not fully. I pushed the config but the retention migration failed during preflight: `ERROR: ALTER TABLE spans_retention failed: role "obs_writer" missing`
Matt: Can you paste the small log snippet?
Priya: Sure:
```
2026-03-17T11:11:55Z migration-job[pid=324]: ERROR: role "obs_writer" does not exist
2026-03-17T11:11:55Z migration-job[pid=324]: failing fast
```
Priya: After that `kubectl rollout status deploy/console-obsv -n staging-obsv` timed out.
Rui: The migration pod runs only on infra-1. Looks like the DB role mapping didn't propagate to infra-1 during the last config sync.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: rollout failed for console-obsv v2.3.1 -> migration-job exit 1 (502).
Omar: Can we rollback the deploy to avoid partial traces?
Clara: Prefer not to rollback if we can fix quickly — rollback leaves traces in inconsistent states. Proposed plan: Priya fixes role propagation, Matt adds a guard in the joiner to tolerate missing span_id so old spans don't break the whole job, Rui will run a manual migration window at 16:00 PST with eng-sre. Please ack.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll push the fix to the role mapping by 14:30 and run a dry run in staging infra-1.
Matt: I'll open a tiny CR to guard the joiner: if span_id missing, increment metric `span_join_skipped` and continue. Will add unit test.
Rui: Manual migration OK for 16:00 PST — I'll coordinate with eng-sre and reserve a 15m window.
Clara: Updated milestone: tracing hook -> staging by EOD if migration & guard pass. Also add test case at `console/obs/tests/test_trace_join.py` for missing span_id.
Omar: I'll add a Grafana alert for duplicate/span-id anomalies (threshold 0.5% of traces) and post the panel once done. Quick Q: retention cutoff change still on for next sprint?
Priya: Retention cutoff still scheduled for next Tuesday, but we'll gate it until the tracing rollout is stable. No migration cutoff until rollout completes.
Matt: CR link: https://git.redwood/CR/1234 — comments welcome, I'll merge after signoff.
Clara: Great. If anything blocks the 16:00 window ping here. Reactions: :eyes: :rocket:
